title: Migrate Kiosk Script to Electron Shell
description: Replace the Chrome-based kiosk launcher with an Electron application that packages the Buddy web app locally, removing the external browser dependency and GitHub Pages requirement.
acceptance_criteria: Electron app loads the local Vite build (dist/) instead of GitHub Pages
npm run kiosk launches the Electron app
App opens in a borderless/frameless window similar to current Chrome app mode

title: Install Electron and create main process entry point
description: Add electron as dev dependency, create electron/main.js with basic window setup

title: Configure Electron to load local dist folder
description: Load dist/index.html in production, set up proper file:// protocol handling

title: Configure frameless window with app-like appearance
description: Set frame: false, window size 1920x1080, disable menu bar, match Chrome app mode behavior

title: Add npm scripts for app mode
description: Add npm run app script that builds and launches Electron app

title: Remove launch-kiosk.sh and clean up Chrome data directory
description: Delete the shell script and .buddy-chrome-data references, update README if needed
